evidence_quotes.O: As a very satisfied owner of an almost antique JBL bookshelf speaker system and a mp3 docking station I can attest to the company's overall craftsmanship.
evidence_quotes.C: one must really do their homework. After researching several systems this model kept popping up on my radar screen.
evidence_quotes.E: Out of the box, my first thoughts on the Micro II was "Wow, it looks just like a yo yo." I like the overall feel and balance.
evidence_quotes.A: its step by step instructions allowed my niece to move from the operating booklet in no time.
evidence_quotes.N: As with most purchases nowadays, there seems to be a lemon in every product. Looks like it was my turn to get one.
